CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any content in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (named red set) is identified and an origin/status is given; the coordinates present how it is organized/presented in the candidate entry.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation or processing condition to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Report text names specific content identifiers (node/color pairs) with explicit coordinate sets.

D.rationale: The text separately attributes provenance/status (origin kinds, record/represented times) to named contents, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented (coordinate groupings per named entry) and gives explicit layout orientation.
